purpose: Replace stage-by-stage model-quality release barriers with one auditable end-to-end engineering vertical slice, then repair the stage actually shown to be limiting.

superseded_drafts.name: front-only progression draft
superseded_drafts.reason: Too narrow: central rear observation can matter during braking or yielding.

superseded_drafts.name: front-plus-back hard progression gate draft
superseded_drafts.reason: Still repeated the same stage-blocking pattern; view quality should be diagnosed during the vertical slice rather than prevent it.

superseded_drafts.name: front-primary progression validator prototype
superseded_drafts.reason: Removed before commit and before model metrics were reviewed because it encoded an unnecessary new hard gate.

development_principle.statement: Complete one bounded version of every interface before repeatedly optimizing an upstream metric. Carry weak model results forward with explicit labels so downstream integration and failure attribution become observable.
development_principle.stage_specific_repair: After the first vertical slice, repair only the stage whose outputs or causal controls fail, then rerun that stage and its downstream consumers.
development_principle.formal_claim_separation: Soft progression during engineering does not weaken later formal release requirements; hard statistical and safety gates return before locked-test evaluation or benchmark claims.

lineage_and_artifact_integrity: input, protocol, checkpoint or report hash mismatch
missing, overwritten or unexpected authoritative artifacts
train/dev/locked-test identity leakage or mutable outcome-selected inputs
responsibility_or_label_leakage: Stage1 receives route, actor, TTC, collision, action, corruption-family or answer labels
task relevance is moved into Stage1 rather than Stage2L
privileged outcomes or answer-derived labels enter the model forward input
planning gradients cross the frozen Stage1 boundary
numerical_interface_and_runtime: non-finite loss, gradients, maps or model outputs
checkpoint cannot load or the declared tensor/view/grid interface is incompatible
job exits without the minimum attested report/checkpoint needed by the next consumer
CARLA or ORION runtime failure prevents a valid control trace

soft_diagnostics_that_do_not_block_the_f: the seven original Job 1121553 factorized-R engineering gates
per-view or per-component recall, AP and background FPR
front, rear, side or oblique-view generalization differences
the current Stage1 native-fog external-validity miss
controlled-U ordering, QA preference or text-consistency quality
absence of a positive corruption-induced failure route
closed-loop collision, TTC or completion improvement in the first smoke

primary_longitudinal_views.CAM_FRONT: Dominant route following and forward conflict relevance.
primary_longitudinal_views.CAM_BACK: Potential task relevance when braking, yielding or reducing speed.

view_analysis_scope.side_and_oblique_views: Auxiliary generalization evidence; sparse support is reported and may later be strengthened through QA or new events rather than blocking the first slice.
view_analysis_scope.current_rear_limit: Actor/CAM_BACK localization does not yet prove braking-conditioned relevance; the QA stage must expose that distinction.

job_1121553_handling.checkpoint_selection: Use the attested terminal checkpoint produced by the unchanged protocol; do not outcome-select an unregistered step.
job_1121553_handling.result_labeling: Record full seven-gate pass/fail and every per-view metric even though they no longer serve as downstream permission switches.

stage2l_semantic_qa.objective: Train one bounded version of the controlled-U to K to structured-QA bridge on the existing engineering data.
stage2l_semantic_qa.inputs: Frozen visual/route/ego context, frozen factorized R, frozen Stage1/U-tokenizer lineage and matched zero/on-path/off-path/shuffled U variants.
stage2l_semantic_qa.rear_semantic_probe: Include braking/yield context versus ordinary forward-travel context with rear U; treat quality as diagnostic in this first run.

stage2p_integration.objective: Connect one bounded semantic output path to the existing trajectory/planning interface without first optimizing every QA metric.
curriculum: controlled or oracle spatial U interface smoke
minimum_outputs: trajectory response for zero, relevant-U and irrelevant-U variants
identity or near-identity behavior on zero-U controls

closed_loop_smoke.objective: Run the complete current-mainline interface in CARLA on a very small development set, even if no aggregate improvement is expected yet.
minimum_outputs: collision, TTC, traffic-rule, completion and unnecessary-slowing diagnostics
per-frame U, R, K, QA/stance and trajectory provenance

post_slice_failure_attribution.U_not_localized_or_not_external: Repair Stage1 supervision or held-out family coverage; retain the downstream interface.
post_slice_failure_attribution.R_not_contextual: Repair Stage2L relevance supervision, QA coverage or event diversity; do not move task relevance into Stage1.
post_slice_failure_attribution.K_or_QA_not_counterfactual: Repair the U/R semantic bridge and structured-language objective.
post_slice_failure_attribution.QA_valid_but_trajectory_unresponsive: Repair Stage2-P conditioning or trajectory loss.
post_slice_failure_attribution.trajectory_changes_but_closed_loop_not_s: Repair policy optimization or scenario selection, using TTC, progress and false-conservatism diagnostics.
post_slice_failure_attribution.multiple_failures: Prioritize the earliest broken causal interface, rerun it, then reuse unchanged downstream tests.

before_locked_test: freeze primary and auxiliary view claims
freeze semantic, false-conservatism and planning gates
freeze closed-loop safety and utility metrics
before_200_route_benchmark: one complete development vertical slice is reproducible
the dominant failure stage has received at least one targeted repair
no outcome-selected test identities or thresholds are used

claim_boundary: Prospective engineering progression policy recorded without reviewing Job 1121553 training metrics. It permits carrying integrity-valid but weak model checkpoints through one bounded vertical slice; it is not a model, language, planning, closed-loop or safety result and authorizes no job by itself.
